content.lowMeshQualityDescription: Switch to lower-detail CSG meshes sooner, at every distance.
content.pauseVoxelizerDescription: Stop terrain/CSG voxelization while it's running.
content.preferredGraphicsApiDescription: Force a specific rendering backend instead of Roblox's own choice.
content.textureQualityOverrideDescription: Force a texture quality level instead of Roblox's automatic setting.
content.graySkyDescription: Replace the sky with flat gray, for debugging or lower-end GPUs.
content.disableDpiScalingDescription: Render at 1:1 pixel scale, ignoring Windows display scaling.
content.renderQualityLevelOverrideDescription: Force render manager (FRM) quality level, 0 for automatic.
content.maxGrassDistanceDescription: Studs from the camera grass keeps rendering out to.
content.minGrassDistanceDescription: Studs from the camera grass always renders within.
content.grassMotionFactorDescription: Scales down how much grass sways; higher is stiller.
content.handleAltEnterDescription: Let Roblox itself handle the Alt+Enter fullscreen toggle.
